name: arcadia
description: One library for Steam, Epic, EA and Ubisoft games
author: JarJarRen
comment:overrides: brace-expansion: GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, a denial of service through
unbounded expansion. The advisory covers <= 5.0.7, which is every
release of every major line, so the usual 'stay on 1.x but patched'
escape does not exist. Six copies were in the tree at 1.1.16, 2.1.2
and 5.0.8; this pins all of them to the fixed release.
npm audit's own remedy is `--force`, which downgrades electron-builder
to 25.1.8 — losing a major version of the packaging tool to fix a
transitive dependency is the wrong trade.
Everything here is a devDependency and the packaged app contains no
node_modules at all, so the exposure is to whoever builds Arcadia,
not to whoever runs it. Verified after pinning: unit tests, typecheck,
the Electron smoke test and a full `npm run dist`, since minimatch 3
and glob 7 now run against a brace-expansion four majors newer than
